title: Vaudreuil → the minister (Berryer), cipher letter, Montréal, eve of the Quebec campaign
correspondents: Pierre de Rigaud de Vaudreuil de Cavagnial → minister of the Marine
status: Title only ("Lettre chiffrée ... au ministre"), no content summary, unlike the deciphered despatches around it: the ANOM/LAC describers apparently could not read it. Not on DECODE, not in repo. Key lead: "Chiffre ou code de Montcalm et de Vaudreuil" 1757-58, ANOM COL C11E 10 ff.285-290v (nouvelle-france.org id 15213, 10 images); Vaudreuil acknowledged receiving the ministry cipher 22 Sept 1756 (C11A 101 f.105).
why: The governor-general's secret despatch on the defence of Canada in spring 1759, before Wolfe's siege of Quebec.
